mixed_use_soak.content: Synthetic views and generated local silent WAV; not real-account streaming
mixed_use_soak.scope: Predates device-pixel-ratio artwork sizing and restored-queue preloading; repeated navigation uses real local playback, not remote extraction

wrapper.account: Real imported account; private track and session data excluded
wrapper.content_match: Exact title, artist and duration matched privately for the native comparison
wrapper.platform: Arch Linux, KDE Wayland; installed Tauri/WebKit wrapper through X11
wrapper.output: Temporary silent PulseAudio sink, removed after the check
wrapper.skip_method: MPRIS command until changed expected metadata, Playing and position above 30 ms and below 3 s; 10 ms polling
wrapper.startup_limitation: Initial resume timing could accept the existing position without proving new progress; excluded from the startup release gate

prepared_resumes.method: 10 ms polling until 30 ms of new playback progress
prepared_resumes.output: same silent PulseAudio sink as native

interaction_diagnostic.content: 10,000 synthetic songs; five-second animated scroll and twenty mute-key responses
interaction_diagnostic.renderer: Offscreen software, with device-pixel-ratio artwork sizing
interaction_diagnostic.scope: Software diagnostic; desktop GPU results are recorded separately

desktop_interaction.content: 10,000 synthetic songs; five-second animated scroll and twenty mute-key responses
desktop_interaction.python_regressions: 112 tests passed after the playback and database follow-ups, including the loopback HTTP download-resume test

native_dummy_output.content: Same two real-account tracks as the wrapper; isolated app data
native_dummy_output.output: libmpv null driver; different from the wrapper's silent PulseAudio device
native_dummy_output.scope: The complete scenario passed, but its first skip exceeded the initial wrapper result. Audio outputs and position-sampling methods must be aligned before concluding streaming equivalence. This is not the final streaming release result.

native_matched_attempt.content: Same two real-account tracks as the wrapper; isolated app data and null audio output
native_matched_attempt.limitation: The harness incorrectly required Qt's single window-state value to equal Minimized. It stopped at that assertion before minimized and skip measurements. Initial resource samples include startup/extraction workers and do not establish steady playback. The revised harness verifies only its own window through KWin, waits for worker idling and reports callback errors immediately.

local_audio_diagnostic.content: Generated silent WAV through the real source worker and libmpv null output

repeated_launch_diagnostic.content: Synthetic fixture in a new process for each launch; includes process creation
repeated_launch_diagnostic.scope: Existing OS file cache; not a machine cold boot or desktop GPU measurement

common_audio_attempt.output: The same temporary silent PulseAudio sink for both clients
common_audio_attempt.wrapper_method: 10 ms polling until at least 30 ms of new playback progress
common_audio_attempt.native_failure: Generic provider error before audio was loaded; exception category is not yet known
common_audio_attempt.isolated_follow_up: The same saved session and private track subsequently resolved successfully in a read-only source check; Node was available
common_audio_attempt.scope: Incomplete comparison; it does not establish equivalent streaming performance

bugs_reproduced_before_fix: Desktop Play changed intent without unpausing an already loaded track while paused-for-cache was true
A failed paused preload could restart unpaused during source retry
buffered_resume_follow_up.fix: Resume the loaded decoder while buffering, keep the explicit pause intent current, and preserve paused selection through retry/end events
buffered_resume_follow_up.targeted_checks: 19 playback, desktop and source tests passed
buffered_resume_follow_up.locally_runnable_suite: 109 passed; the unchanged HTTP server test requires the host socket permission
buffered_resume_follow_up.generated_pulse_audio_probe: User verified the pulse backend, one stream, advancing silent local audio and no warnings/errors
buffered_resume_follow_up.remaining_verification: Shared-output real-account comparison passed; details are in native_common_output
buffered_resume_follow_up.additional_check: A restored end-of-song position stays paused on the same song and explicit Play restarts it from zero

environment_limitation: Automatic approval review intermittently fails because its model is at capacity. The wrapper baseline was completed using the prepared harness in the user's terminal. The native harness is prepared for the same fallback.

native_common_output.output: Same temporary silent PulseAudio sink as wrapper
native_common_output.scope: Prepared current-track resumes and queue skips, with 10 ms polling for 30 ms of new progress. Cold remote extraction is reported separately as paused preload time. This run precedes the database initialization follow-up.

repeated_gpu_launches.content: Synthetic shell; each sample starts a new app process
repeated_gpu_launches.scope: Existing OS file cache; not a machine cold boot

local_pulse_audio_starts.method: 10 ms polling until the expected new local path has 30 ms playback progress

database_startup_follow_up.reproduced: Both media and metadata stores failed concurrent fresh-database initialization with SQLITE_BUSY before the fix
database_startup_follow_up.fix: Bounded retry only for SQLite busy/locked journal-mode transitions; other database errors propagate
database_startup_follow_up.verification: Both concurrent initialization regressions pass, including 120 real database opens
database_startup_follow_up.relationship_to_preload_failure: A reproduced plausible cause; the original account preload exception was not captured

limitations: The stable 30-minute synthetic soak ran on the recorded parent revision before the final playback, artwork and database follow-ups.
Launch samples use existing OS file caches; the GPU repeats render synthetic UI while the separate account comparison supplies actual desktop shell timing.
Streaming click timings cover prepared current tracks and queued skips; asynchronous cold extraction is reported separately.
Physical sleep/wake remains deferred at the user's request; see linux-verification.json.
